semiconductor_relevance: High — SCREEN SPE Services provides essential maintenance and support services for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, which is critical for operational efficiency.
summary: SCREEN SPE Services specializes in the setup and maintenance of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, along with the sale of peripheral equipment and safety tools. They have established a global training center to enhance their service capabilities and support the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: New setup and maintenance of semiconductor manufacturing equipment

regional_presence.Japan: The company has a training center located at their Kumamoto plant, focusing on state-of-the-art equipment.
